text:
marta: FYI, early canary run for new onboarded model vanguard-2q (int8) is showing a parse_failure spike on toolcall corpus — parse_failure_rate jumped from ~0.8% to 6.3% starting at 10:12 UTC. :eyes:
ryan: which corpus slice / sample size?
marta: bench-ci ran the 5k-toolcall slice, sample id slice-2026-03-23-a. config: model=vanguard-2q, quant=int8, batch=8, kv_cache=enabled, streaming=on.
bench-ci: quick summary from CI run:
```
canary: vanguard-2q-int8
samples: 5000
parse_failure_rate: 0.063
funcall_invalid_rate: 0.047
most_common_err: JSONParseError(trailing-data)
```
ash: do we have a concrete example of model output that failed parsing?
marta: pasted one below (redacted user prompt):
```
{"action":"call","name":"get_user","arguments":{"id":"123"}}}


{"action":"call","name":"get_user","arguments":{"id":"124"}}
```
ryan: looks like an extra brace + then another JSON blob appended. Could be streaming boundary or tokenizer split making the model emit a partial close and then re-output.
samir: also suspicious: kv_cache+batching can produce duplicated suffixes if prefix reconstruction happens. We've seen similar with int8 rounding before.
ash: timeline: did this spike appear only after quantization to int8 or after other changes?
marta: canary rollout: introduced int8 quant profile + a kernel change (attention fuse v2) in the same push. Baseline int16 canary earlier at 0.9% parse_failure. So likely quant + kernel interaction.
ryan: immediate triage plan: 1) reproduce deterministic failing sample with streaming disabled 2) rerun canary with kv_cache=off 3) run int16 kernel-v2 to isolate quant vs kernel.
ash: agree. I can run (1) and (3) now. samir can you try (2) and also run the parser-repair heuristic counts?
samir: on it. running: `/bench/runner --canary=vanguard-2q --slice=slice-2026-03-23-a --overrides kv_cache=false --metrics parse_examples --limit 1000`
bench-ci: queued, job id bc-7187. should be ~12m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot detected related alert: canary-vanguard-2q parse_failure_rate > 5% for 10m, paging threshold breached.
ryan: don't escalate yet, this is canary. but we should stop promoting this canary to larger traffic until proved.
marta: added a temporary rule to routing: block vanguard-2q-int8 from dedicated and hosted until triage completes.
ash: quick repro results for int16+kernel-v2: parse_failure_rate = 0.011 on same slice. so kernel-v2 by itself doesn't explain 6.3%.
samir: kv_cache off run (bc-7187) initial stream: parse_failure_rate = 0.014 after 1k samples. so kv_cache seems to be the large factor.
ryan: good signal. hypothesis: int8 quantization + kv_cache replay leads to boundary artifact where the model emits repeated/garbage suffix when cache policy reconstructs prefixes. Maybe some rounding causes probability mass to shift to producing an extra brace as token.
marta: actionable fixes: A) disable kv_cache for int8 quant profile by default until we patch runtime B) add a soft JSON post-processor: if parse fails, try trimmed-suffix heuristic (strip trailing non-json tokens up to 128 chars) then re-parse; C) add unit tests to canary harness that include streaming-split golden set.
ash: I can land (B) as a temporary canary-side postprocess in the SDK (python/json_repair). small diff: `def repair_json(s): return re.sub(r"[^\\{\\}\\[\\]\\"\\w\\:\\,\\n]*$","",s)` — quick but OK for canary.
samir: also propose to add a parser-telemetry tag to every repaired invocation so we can measure repair effectiveness and false positives.
ryan: we should run a targeted eval: run repaired parser over the 5k slice and compute: repaired_success_rate, false_repair_rate (where repaired parse differs from gold).
marta: assigning owners: samir -> implement kv_cache gating for int8 and telemetry; ash -> add parser repair in SDK canary; ry an -> coordinate reruns and regression dashboard; marta -> update routing block and notify product.
bench-ci: scheduled full rerun (5k) with repairs=on, kv_cache=off, job id bc-7188. output will post to: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-7188 when done.
ops-bot: note: we should also check billing/latency impact of disabling kv_cache for int8 — may increase p99 token cost.
ash: for followups: we should also reproduce with streaming=true/false across batch sizes 1/8/32 to find boundary. putting a small matrix run in the queue.
ryan: thanks. please post any minimal failing examples into the #eng-ml-dumps S3 bucket so we can add to golden set.
marta: summary: root cause suspected kv_cache+int8 boundary artifact; immediate mitigation = block vanguard-2q-int8 from promotion + kv_cache gating; short-term repair=parser soft-trim; next steps = targeted matrix runs + telemetry + add golden failing examples. owners assigned.
ash: thanks all. :thumbsup:
ryan: will update this thread with bc-7188 results.
bench-ci: bc-7188 completed: repaired_success_rate=0.058 -> overall parse_failure reduced to 0.009; false_repair_rate estimate=0.002 (on gold subset). full log: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-7188/logs
marta: closing loop once dashboard shows stable <1% parse_failure on vanguard-2q-int8 with kv_cache gating and repairs. documented triage in Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/onboard/vanguard-2q-triage
ryan: we'll keep the routing block for 24h and revisit.
ops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-7187.
marta: end of thread.
